lines: Release week on Tilo. G T A six comes out on the nineteenth of November. Draw while you wait.
This week's shared wall is a coast at sunset. The billboard is blank, the road is empty, and the big wheel is waiting.
Members fill it in by hand: cars, neon signs, people, boats. It's up now, until the twentieth.
On the eighteenth, the subject is: yourself, as a loading screen. Six sunset inks, and ten minutes.
To set the mood, Claude, an AI, drew a few samples in code. They're marked AI-made. Beat them by hand.
Open tiloart dot com, press the bar at the top, and draw along. Stamp the best ones.
Release week, on Tilo. Free, at tiloart dot com.
